name: std-learn-scatter-fit
description: Generic scatter-plot fitting instrument — points on a math-canvas (config-declared axis ranges/labels/colors) with a live least-squares refit: slope, intercept, r, and R² recompute as points are added (button or auto-add tick, up to maxPoints) or dragged. An optional guess-then-reveal mode lets the learner drag slope/intercept sliders to propose a line, scored against the fit until Reveal Fit; dashed residual segments and the r/R² readout are config-toggleable. Run/Pause drives a fixed-interval auto-add tick, Reset reseeds from the configured point roster. SCATTER_FIT_UPDATED broadcasts the fit after every learner action, tick, or reset. Every button label, caption, curve label/color, and narration phrase is config-declared so the same mechanism serves any scatter-fit domain (correlation, physics data fitting, trend lines, and beyond) on a math-canvas. Standalone by default; behind a lab router set matchMode and it renders only when MODE_SELECTED matches.

schema.name: std-learn-scatter-fit

autoRun.description: When true, INIT/MODE_SELECTED start the tick auto-adding points up to Max Points; toggle live with the Run/Pause button.
autoRun.label: Auto Run

axisXMax.description: Upper bound of the canvas x axis, in data coordinates; also the x endpoint the fit/guess lines are drawn to.
axisXMax.label: X Axis Max

axisXMin.description: Lower bound of the canvas x axis, in data coordinates.
axisXMin.label: X Axis Min

axisYMax.description: Upper bound of the canvas y axis; also the ceiling curve samples clamp to and the high end of the guess-intercept slider default range.
axisYMax.label: Y Axis Max

axisYMin.description: Lower bound of the canvas y axis; also the floor curve samples clamp to and the low end of the guess-intercept slider default range.
axisYMin.label: Y Axis Min

fitLabel.description: Legend label for the computed least-squares fit line.
fitLabel.label: Fit Curve Label

gridStep.description: Spacing between canvas gridlines, in data coordinates.
gridStep.label: Grid Step

guessInterceptCaption.description: Text prefixed to the current guess-intercept value above its slider.
guessInterceptCaption.label: Guess Intercept Caption

guessInterceptMax.description: Upper bound of the guess-intercept slider; typically set to axisYMax.
guessInterceptMax.label: Guess Intercept Max

guessInterceptMin.description: Lower bound of the guess-intercept slider; typically set to axisYMin.
guessInterceptMin.label: Guess Intercept Min

guessLabel.description: Legend label for the learner's proposed line, shown while guessMode is on and the fit isn't yet revealed.
guessLabel.label: Guess Curve Label

guessMode.description: When true the learner's guessed line is shown instead of the fit until Reveal Fit, and the guess is scored against least squares.
guessMode.label: Guess Mode
guessMode.synonyms: guess the line, prediction, estimate the fit

guessSlopeCaption.description: Text prefixed to the current guess-slope value above its slider.
guessSlopeCaption.label: Guess Slope Caption

guessSlopeMax.description: Upper bound of the guess-slope slider.
guessSlopeMax.label: Guess Slope Max

guessSlopeMin.description: Lower bound of the guess-slope slider.
guessSlopeMin.label: Guess Slope Min

initialPoints.description: Scatter points the canvas starts with, in axis data coordinates; Reset reseeds from this roster.
initialPoints.label: Initial Points
initialPoints.synonyms: seed points, dataset, scatter data, sample

interactive.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas — required for dragging points.
interactive.label: Interactive

matchMode.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.
matchMode.label: Match Mode

maxPoints.description: Cap on accumulated scatter points; Add Point and the auto-run tick stop once reached, until Reset.
maxPoints.label: Max Points

narrationAddedTemplate.description: Narration phrase after a point is added (button or tick), assembled as "<template> <n> — r = .., R² = ..".
narrationAddedTemplate.label: Added Narration Template

narrationAutoAddingTemplate.default: Auto-adding — tick adds a new point.
narrationAutoAddingTemplate.description: Narration shown after Run is pressed.
narrationAutoAddingTemplate.label: Auto-Adding Narration

narrationFitRevealedTemplate.description: Narration phrase after Reveal Fit, assembled as "<template> — r = .., R² = .. — guess score <score>%".
narrationFitRevealedTemplate.label: Fit Revealed Narration Template

narrationGuessUpdatedTemplate.description: Narration phrase after a guess slider moves, assembled as "<template> <score>%".
narrationGuessUpdatedTemplate.label: Guess Updated Narration Template

narrationLoadedTemplate.description: Narration phrase after INIT/MODE_SELECTED/Reset load the seed points, assembled as "<n> <template> — r = .., R² = ..".
narrationLoadedTemplate.label: Loaded Narration Template

narrationMaxReachedSuffix.description: Suffix appended to the added-point narration once maxPoints is hit.
narrationMaxReachedSuffix.label: Max Reached Narration Suffix

narrationMovedTemplate.description: Narration phrase after a point is dragged, assembled as "<template> — r = .., R² = ..".
narrationMovedTemplate.label: Moved Narration Template

narrationPausedTemplate.default: Paused — add manually with Add Point.
narrationPausedTemplate.description: Narration shown after Pause is pressed.
narrationPausedTemplate.label: Paused Narration

newPointColor.description: Fill color assigned to points created by Add Point or the auto-add tick.
newPointColor.label: New Point Color

pointMarginPct.description: Fraction of each axis span kept clear at both ends when Add Point/the tick place a new random point, so new points never land flush against the axis edge.
pointMarginPct.label: Point Margin Percent

showR.description: Show the correlation coefficient r and coefficient of determination R² under the canvas.
showR.label: Show r and R²
showR.synonyms: correlation coefficient, r squared, goodness of fit

showResiduals.description: Draw a dashed segment from each point to the fit line — the errors least squares minimizes.
showResiduals.label: Show Residuals

emits.description: The least-squares fit and narration after each learner action, auto-add tick, or reset — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
emits.synonyms: fit update, line of best fit, slope, intercept, correlation, r squared

emits.description: Fired once when the point that reaches maxPoints lands and the round latches done — the standard learning completion broadcast a celebration/progression sibling (fx cues, badges) rides.
emits.synonyms: round complete, finished, done, completion, max points

events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.
events.name: Mode Selected

events.description: A scatter point was dragged — id names the point, x/y its new coordinates (clamped to the axis ranges); the fit recomputes live.
events.name: Drag Point

events.description: Learner dragged a guess-the-line slider — param is slope or intercept; the guess is scored against the least-squares fit.
events.name: Guess Line

events.description: The least-squares fit and narration after each learner action, auto-add tick, or reset — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.name: Learn Scatter Fit Updated

app std-learn-scatter-fit "1.0.0"

orbital LearnScatterFitOrbital {
  type LearnScatterFitPoint = {
    id : string
    x : number!
    y : number!
    label : string
    color : string
    radius : number
  }
  type LearnScatterFitCurve = {
    label : string
    color : string
    dash : "dashed" | "dotted"
    samples : [LearnScatterFitCurvePoint]
  }
  type LearnScatterFitCurvePoint = {
    x : number!
    y : number!
  }

  entity LearnScatterFitScene [runtime] {
    id : string!
    active : boolean = false
    title : string
    points : [LearnScatterFitPoint]
    slope : number
    intercept : number
    r : number
    rSquared : number
    guessSlope : number
    guessIntercept : number
    guessScore : number
    revealed : boolean = false
    running : boolean = false
    done : boolean = false
    curves : [LearnScatterFitCurve]
    narration : string
  }

  trait LearnScatterFitSim -> @rebindable LearnScatterFitScene [interaction, instance] {
    initial: idle

    state idle {
      INIT -> idle when (== @config.matchMode "")
        (set @entity.active true)
        (set @entity.title @config.title)
        (set @entity.points @config.initialPoints)
        (set @entity.guessSlope 0)
        (set @entity.guessIntercept (/ (+ @config.axisYMin @config.axisYMax) 2))
        (set @entity.revealed false)
        (set @entity.running @config.autoRun)
        (let (
            (pts @config.initialPoints)
            (n (array/len @pts))
            (meanX (if (> @n 0) (/ (array/reduce @pts 0 (fn (acc p) (+ @acc (object/get @p x)))) @n) 0))
            (meanY (if (> @n 0) (/ (array/reduce @pts 0 (fn (acc p) (+ @acc (object/get @p y)))) @n) 0))
            (sxx (array/reduce @pts 0 (fn (acc p) (let ((dx (- (object/get @p x) @meanX))) (+ @acc (* @dx @dx))))))
            (syy (array/reduce @pts 0 (fn (acc p) (let ((dy (- (object/get @p y) @meanY))) (+ @acc (* @dy @dy))))))
            (sxy (array/reduce @pts 0 (fn (acc p) (+ @acc (* (- (object/get @p x) @meanX) (- (object/get @p y) @meanY))))))
            (newSlope (if (> @sxx 0) (/ @sxy @sxx) 0))
            (newIntercept (- @meanY (* @newSlope @meanX)))
            (newR (if (and (> @sxx 0) (> @syy 0)) (/ @sxy (math/sqrt (* @sxx @syy))) 0))
            (fitCurve { label: @config.fitLabel, color: @config.fitColor, samples: [
              { x: @config.axisXMin, y: (math/clamp @newIntercept @config.axisYMin @config.axisYMax) },
              { x: @config.axisXMax, y: (math/clamp (+ (* @newSlope @config.axisXMax) @newIntercept) @config.axisYMin @config.axisYMax) }
            ]})
            (residualCurves (if @config.showResiduals

              []))
          )
          (do
            (set @entity.slope @newSlope)
            (set @entity.intercept @newIntercept)
            (set @entity.r @newR)
            (set @entity.rSquared (* @newR @newR))
            (set @entity.guessScore 0)
            (set @entity.curves (array/concat (array/append [] @fitCurve) @residualCurves))
            (set @entity.done (>= @n @config.maxPoints))
            (set @entity.narration (str/concat (str/concat "" @n) " " @config.narrationLoadedTemplate " — r = " (str/concat "" (math/round @newR 3)) ", R² = " (str/concat "" (math/round (* @newR @newR) 3))))

                { type: math-canvas, width: @config.width, height: @config.height, xMin: @config.axisXMin, xMax: @config.axisXMax, yMin: @config.axisYMin, yMax: @config.axisYMax, showAxes: @config.showAxes, showGrid: @config.showGrid, gridStep: @config.gridStep, showTickLabels: @config.showTickLabels, curves: @entity.curves, points: @entity.points, vectors: [], interactive: @config.interactive, animate: @config.animate },

                { type: typography, variant: body, content: @entity.narration }

          )
          (do
            (set @entity.slope @newSlope)

            (sxy (array/reduce @pts 0 (fn (acc p) (+ @acc (* (- (object/get @p x) @meanX) (- (object/get @p y) @meanY))))))
            (newSlope (if (> @sxx 0) (/ @sxy @sxx) 0))
            (newIntercept (- @meanY (* @newSlope @meanX)))
            (newR (if (and (> @sxx 0) (> @syy 0)) (/ @sxy (math/sqrt (* @sxx @syy))) 0))
            (fitCurve { label: @config.fitLabel, color: @config.fitColor, samples: [
              { x: @config.axisXMin, y: (math/clamp @newIntercept @config.axisYMin @config.axisYMax) },
              { x: @config.axisXMax, y: (math/clamp (+ (* @newSlope @config.axisXMax) @newIntercept) @config.axisYMin @config.axisYMax) }
            ]})
            (guessCurve { label: @config.guessLabel, color: @config.guessColor, samples: [
              { x: @config.axisXMin, y: (math/clamp @entity.guessIntercept @config.axisYMin @config.axisYMax) },
              { x: @config.axisXMax, y: (math/clamp (+ (* @entity.guessSlope @config.axisXMax) @entity.guessIntercept) @config.axisYMin @config.axisYMax) }
            ]})
            (residualCurves (if @config.showResiduals
              (array/map @pts (fn p { label: "", color: @config.residualColor, dash: @config.residualDash, samples: [ { x: (object/get @p x), y: (object/get @p y) }, { x: (object/get @p x), y: (+ (* @newSlope (object/get @p x)) @newIntercept) } ] }))
              []))
            (baseCurves (if (and @config.guessMode (not @entity.revealed))
              (array/append [] @guessCurve)
              (if @config.guessMode
                (array/append (array/append [] @guessCurve) @fitCurve)
                (array/append [] @fitCurve))))
            (nowDone (>= @n @config.maxPoints))
          )
          (do
            (set @entity.points @pts)
            (set @entity.slope @newSlope)
            (set @entity.intercept @newIntercept)
            (set @entity.r @newR)
            (set @entity.rSquared (* @newR @newR))
            (set @entity.curves (array/concat @baseCurves @residualCurves))
            (set @entity.done @nowDone)
            (set @entity.narration (str/concat @config.narrationAddedTemplate " " (str/concat "" @n) " — r = " (str/concat "" (math/round @newR 3)) ", R² = " (str/concat "" (math/round (* @newR @newR) 3)) (if @nowDone @config.narrationMaxReachedSuffix "")))
            (if @nowDone (emit LEARN_ROUND_COMPLETE { score: @n, total: @config.maxPoints }) null)
          )
        )
        (render-ui main {
          type: box
          padding: md
          children: [
            { type: stack, direction: vertical, gap: md, children: [
                { type: typography, variant: h4, content: @entity.title },
                { type: stack, direction: horizontal, gap: sm, children: [
                    { type: button, action: ADD_POINT, label: @config.addPointLabel, variant: primary },
                    { type: button, action: REVEAL_FIT, label: @config.revealLabel, variant: secondary },
                    { type: button, action: TOGGLE_RUN, label: (if @entity.running @config.pauseLabel @config.runLabel), variant: secondary },
                    { type: button, action: RESET, label: @config.resetLabel, variant: ghost }
                  ] },
                { type: typography, variant: caption, content: (str/concat @config.guessSlopeCaption (math/round @entity.guessSlope 2)) },
                { type: range-slider, min: @config.guessSlopeMin, max: @config.guessSlopeMax, step: @config.guessSlopeStep, value: @entity.guessSlope, showTooltip: true, action: "GUESS_LINE", actionPayload: { param: "slope" } },
                { type: typography, variant: caption, content: (str/concat @config.guessInterceptCaption (math/round @entity.guessIntercept 1)) },
                { type: range-slider, min: @config.guessInterceptMin, max: @config.guessInterceptMax, step: @config.guessInterceptStep, value: @entity.guessIntercept, showTooltip: true, action: "GUESS_LINE", actionPayload: { param: "intercept" } },
                { type: math-canvas, width: @config.width, height: @config.height, xMin: @config.axisXMin, xMax: @config.axisXMax, yMin: @config.axisYMin, yMax: @config.axisYMax, showAxes: @config.showAxes, showGrid: @config.showGrid, gridStep: @config.gridStep, showTickLabels: @config.showTickLabels, curves: @entity.curves, points: @entity.points, vectors: [], interactive: @config.interactive, animate: @config.animate },
                { type: typography, variant: body, content: (if @config.showR (str/concat "r = " (math/round @entity.r 3) " — R² = " (math/round @entity.rSquared 3) " — guess score " @entity.guessScore "%") "") },
                { type: typography, variant: body, content: @entity.narration }
              ] }
          ]
        })
        (emit LEARN_SCATTER_FIT_UPDATED { slope: @entity.slope, intercept: @entity.intercept, r: @entity.r, rSquared: @entity.rSquared, pointCount: (array/len @entity.points), narration: @entity.narration })
